note:
391 -> 396, AND NOT ONE OF THE 5 IS DRIFT.

`odoo.tools` measures 396 at f4031cf8d2f -- the commit that banked 391 -- and 396
at HEAD. Diffed file by file between the two: no file moves by one. The scope has
not changed in either direction; the floor was simply banked against a tree that
was never committed, the same way its sibling `mypy` floor was, and has been red
by 5 for every run since.

Measured per §9.3 in detached worktrees, a fresh venv holding mypy==2.3.0 and
nothing else, `--no-incremental`, `-p odoo.tools` as py_typecheck.yml runs it.
Banked at the number a commit reproduces so the next session can tell a
regression from the gap -- which is the whole of what an exact ratchet is for,
and what neither of these two floors could do.
